title: puya alpestris
intro: Puya alpestris, commonly known as the Mountain Puya, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Bromeliaceae family. It is a succulent species native to the Andes mountains in South America. Puya alpestris has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and wounds, due to its health benefits, which include antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Puya alpestris include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
